title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (go) — review required
description: In go, .Queryw*s*([^)]*+ mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via $1 placeholders.
applicability: go codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
